# The text of the button mapping that serializeButtonMappings() in wasm/platform/button_mapping.js writes for the stored
# mapping of tests/unit/button-mapping.test.js, and that ParseControllerMappings() in wasm/controller_mapping.hpp reads
# (tests/native/controller_mapping_test.cpp), so both sides keep the same format: A and B swapped for every controller;
# an Xbox controller (its id as the stream sees it, 63 bytes) with D-pad left and right swapped and a calibrated left
# stick; and an 8BitDo controller with the buttons of every controller and a calibrated right stick. Lines starting with
# # are comments.
